'''Ghost ships''' were a controversial belief&mdash;or even a phenomenon&mdash;in some areas of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

Ghost ships were old [[Starship/Legends|starships]] that were somehow destroyed or lost mysteriously and their fate would become an object of legend and awe; for some reason, they would be believed to visit the locations they were lost in again and again, along with the spirits of their [[Death/Legends|dead]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]]. It was unknown how many of these legends were purely superstition or actual phenomena, and whether they were in any way related to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], such as [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghosts]].

Examples included the [[Ghost Ship of Veragi]],<ref name="SWTOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Investigation|Specter in Space}}</ref> and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Fa'rey]]'s ship which haunted the [[Daragon Trail]].<ref name="Destiny's Way">''[[The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way]]''</ref> The ''[[Dusty Duck]]'' also became the subject of local ghost stories and fables on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] after the death of its pilot, [[Aneesa Dym]], at the hands of [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]].

The [[Dreighton Triangle]], considered to be a haunted locale, was a legend that had originated from the massacre at the [[Battle of Dreighton]]. This legend was an ideal background for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to construct their [[TIE/ph "Phantom" Multi-Role Stealth Starfighter/Legends|Phantom TIEs]], whose mysterious appearances would further fertilize it.

Because of the [[Eclipse (Eclipse-class)|''Eclipse'']]{{'s}} obsidian-black hull seemingly vanished in [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]] when it exited [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] forces initially thought it was a ghost ship, although they quickly learned otherwise when it opened fire, as New Republic information [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Nara Dun]] later recalled.
